info.title: Phone Number Validator: E.164 Format, Country & Line Type
info.description:
Validate phone numbers: E.164, country and line type. Not a live carrier lookup.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/phone-number-validator
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/phone-number-validator
Author: Public Records.
